purpose: Independently audit algebraic self-adjointness, zero row sum, and room-connected boundary-edge reciprocity of exact original native PFFDTD seven-point cartesian rigid Neumann operator, before observing its graph metrics.

geometry_source.required_original_exact_vox_out_sha256: the five per-grid original_solver_geometry_sha256 values in committed prior evidence

matrix.nonboundary_rows: nb_stencil_air_cart: L_ii=-6 and 6 neighbors +1 for all strictly interior nodes
matrix.active_domain: reachability from frozen source nearest air/interior node using native directed edges; do not add artificial external air connected components
matrix.outside_halo: exclude native ghost nodes at grid index 0 or N-1 from active edge counts
matrix.graph_symmetry: all native interior active edges must possess reverse edge in active room graph; if asymmetric preserve directed counts and representative IDs
matrix.conservation: every evaluated interior row L applied to constant 1 must equal 0
matrix.quadratic_form: for deterministic finite float fields u and v, compute u.Lv - v.Lu and report actual relative magnitude; no corrective symmetrization
matrix.native_kernel_crosscheck: run pinned numba nb_stencil_air_cart and nb_stencil_bn_cart on frozen original mask and compare sampled full-domain rows with independently reconstructed graph action
